en: The great stone door slid open...
There's an old switch set into the floor right at your feet. Step down on it?
Something heavy rumbled behind the door and fell quiet. It feels just as it did when you first came in.
Clunk! Something heavy ground into a new place on the far side of the door...
The switch sank a little under your foot and sprang back up. Nothing seems to have happened...
That door puzzles me. Go through it by daylight and you come out in one hall. Go through it by night and it's another!
